title: Skip global option values when matching reserved subcommands
what: `anvil --root . orchestrator off` let an executor turn orchestrator mode off because the first non-flag word was read as the subcommand.
why: `--root` takes a value; role checks must parse global options like clap does.
learned: When adding a global option to cli.rs, update anvil_subcommand; unknown flags before the subcommand are treated as unparsed and reserved words stay denied.
author: reactive-end
